lines.text: زعفران بنویسند و هم در انوقت در پیچیده با خود نگاه دارند از کید و مکر دشمن ایمن باشند
lines.en: they should write with saffron, and also at that time wrap it and keep it with themselves, they will be safe from the deceit and trickery of the enemy.

lines.text: و چون مصافی یا خصومتی دست دهد در حال ان نوشته را از هم بگشایند مسکن ان اشوب بشود
lines.en: And when a battle or enmity occurs, immediately they should open that writing from each other, it will become the pacifier of that turmoil

lines.text: و فتح و ظفر روی نماید (احکام شرف زهره) دلالت کند بر قوة حال خواتین و مطربان و خوام
lines.en: and victory and triumph will appear. (Judgments of the exaltation of Venus) It indicates the strength of the condition of women, musicians, and singers,

lines.text: سرائیان و بسیاری لعب و فرح و طرب در مردم و صحت بیماران و کثرت نکاحها سیما دوشیزگان
lines.en: and much play, joy, and merriment among the people, and the health of the sick, and the abundance of marriages, especially of virgins,

lines.text: و کثرت ضیافت و سور و سلامت اشجار و اثمار و رواج بازار اقمشه خاصه ابریشمینه (تنبیه)
lines.en: and the abundance of banquets and feasts, and the safety of trees and fruits, and the briskness of the market for fabrics, especially silken ones. (Warning)

lines.text: افضل المحققین علامه طوسی میفرماید که اقوی کواکب در شرف و سرور و اعتباله زهره است
lines.en: The most excellent of the verifiers, Allamah Tusi, says that the strongest of the planets in exaltation and joy and its dignity is Venus,

lines.text: لیکن چون از درجه شرف تجاوز نماید مهموم و محزون گردد از جهت مفارقت برج شرف و مواصلت
lines.en: but when it passes the degree of exaltation, it becomes anxious and sorrowful because of the separation from the sign of exaltation and the connection

lines.text: برج حمل که وبال و ضد بیت او است (تنبیه) مولنا شرف الدین علی یزدی اورده که چون
lines.en: to the sign of Aries, which is its detriment and the opposite of its house. (Warning) Our master Sharaf al-Din Ali Yazdi has brought that when

lines.text: زهره بدرجه شرف یا حوالی ان در اید و قمر در ثور و سرطان بود مربع وفق پنج در پنج را بر ورق
lines.en: Venus enters the degree of exaltation or its vicinity, and the Moon is in Taurus and Cancer, a magic square of five by five on a leaf

lines.text: اهو بنویسند و بوقت سعادت زهره در پیچند با خود نگاه دارند در مجامعت و مباشرت
lines.en: of deer they should write, and at the time of the auspiciousness of Venus they should wrap it and keep it with themselves, in intercourse and association

lines.text: اثر عظیم کند (احکام شرف عطارد) دلالت کند بر رونق دواوین و قوت حال مستوفیان
lines.en: it will have a great effect. (Judgments of the exaltation of Mercury) It indicates the briskness of the divans and the strength of the condition of the accountants

lines.text: و متصرفان و تحویلداران و تجار و اهل قلم و علماء و شعرا و اطباء و اهل تنجیم و میل مردم بتعلیم
lines.en: and the administrators and the cashiers and the merchants and the people of the pen and the scholars and the poets and the physicians and the people of astrology, and the inclination of the people to teaching

lines.text: و تعلم معقولات و رواج بازار کتاب و رونق پیشه کاران و رسیدن اخبار ساره (تنبیه)
lines.en: and learning rational sciences, and the briskness of the book market, and the briskness of craftsmen, and the arrival of glad tidings. (Warning)

lines.text: در کتاب کنز المراد مذکور است که چون عطارد بدرجه شرف واصل شود مربع هفت در هفت را
lines.en: In the book Kanz al-Murad it is mentioned that when Mercury reaches the degree of exaltation, a magic square of seven by seven

lines.text: بمشك و زعفران و گلاب بر کرباس نو یا پاره کتان رقم کنند و چون قمر در شرف باشد کرباس را
lines.en: with musk and saffron and rosewater on new canvas or a piece of linen they should draw, and when the Moon is in exaltation, the canvas

lines.text: شسته بخورد مسحور دهند ان عمل باطل گردد و اگر داخل طعام کرده بخورند کیاست بیفزاید
lines.en: washed they should give to the bewitched to drink, that spell will be nullified, and if they put it in food and eat it, it will increase sagacity.

lines.text: (احکام هبوط شمس) دلالت کند بر تنزل و تزلزل خاطر ملوك و سرداران و بزرگان
lines.en: (Judgments of the fall of the Sun) It indicates the decline and shaking of the minds of kings and commanders and great ones,

lines.text: و کساد بازارها و جور و بیداد حکام و خنکی هوا و ارزانی اسب و کساد بازار صرافان و
lines.en: and the dullness of the markets, and the tyranny and injustice of the rulers, and the coldness of the weather, and the cheapness of horses, and the dullness of the market of moneychangers and

lines.text: ضرابان و ارزانی طلا و لعل و یاقوت و زحمت اتشکاران و بیماری مغارث (احکام هبوط
lines.en: minters, and the cheapness of gold and ruby and sapphire, and the trouble of fire-workers, and the illness of ... (Judgments of the fall

lines.text: قمر) دلالت کند بر تشویش و تفرقه عامه و گفتگو در بازارها و بستگی کارها و بیماری
lines.en: of the Moon) It indicates the anxiety and dispersion of the common people, and talk in the markets, and the blockage of affairs, and the illness

lines.text: عورات و اطفال و بدحالی مسافران و خرید و فروخت بی نفع و فائده و خوف از لشکریان
lines.en: of women and children, and the bad condition of travelers, and buying and selling without profit and benefit, and fear of soldiers

lines.text: و حدوث اراجیف و قوع باران در وقت (احکام هبوط زحل) دلالت کند بر ضعف
lines.en: and the occurrence of rumors, and the falling of rain at the time. (Judgments of the fall of Saturn) It indicates the weakness

lines.text: حال ملوك قدیم و تفرقه اشراف و رؤسا و صحرانشینان و نقصان کشت و زرع و بیماریها
lines.en: of the condition of old kings, and the dispersion of nobles and chiefs and nomads, and the decrease of crops and agriculture, and illnesses

Judgments of the fall of the Sun

summary.headline: Exaltations and Falls of Planets
summary.text: Astrological judgments of Venus and Mercury in exaltation, including effects on women, commerce, learning, markets, health, and marriages, with talismanic prescriptions. The falls of the Sun, Moon, and Saturn are associated with unrest among rulers and common people, market decline, illness, weather, agriculture, and social disorder; authorities cited include Allamah Tusi, Sharaf al-Din Ali Yazdi, and Kanz al-Murad.
